controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Requires an additional factor when a password is used.

controls.name: Role-Based Access Control
controls.description: Restricts access according to the user's intended role.

controls.name: Session Timeout
controls.description: Limits how long an inactive authenticated session remains usable.

controls.name: Account Disablement
controls.description: Prevents a former worker from using a disabled identity.

controls.name: Privileged Re-authentication
controls.description: Requires additional authentication before sensitive privileged administrative access is allowed.

controls.name: Trusted Device Restriction
controls.description: Prevents access from an unmanaged or untrusted device session.
